diagnostics.message: routes 2 activities and has no "stranded" template (names "undefined"). A multi-step run can stop in the middle, and the two honest things to say about that are different: `compensated` means everything that ran was undone, `stranded` means something that ran could not be. Falling back to `failed` would tell the customer NOTHING happened while a real mutation sits in the store.
